criteria.text: I can start a fresh evidence-enabled workflow with my complete declared unchanged corpus from an explicitly identified approved commit, without editing its scenarios or reapproving unchanged prompt content.
I see adoption refused for a foreign source, unavailable approved snapshot, an approved commit unrelated to my selected base, or missing explicit external human approval assertion.
I see adoption refused when a declared scenario is omitted or missing, the selected inventory has extra rows, or its raw bytes or original check identities change.
I see adoption refused when the current prompt or any required dependency differs from the approved source.
I keep the original repository, commit, declared scenario scope and human approval reference, with a clear warning that pdd cannot independently authenticate that external authorization.
